generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Tenderer must be Registered in BWSSB or Equivalent registration with KPWD/CPWD etc., & shall furnish valid registration certificate which is in Currency
Assessed available tender capacity is (A x N x 2.5)-B should be more than Amount put to tender i.e Rs.75.35 Lakhs
The Tenderer should have in the last 5 years period achieved in at-least TWO Financial Years an average Annual Financial Turnover of Rupees Not less than Rs.75.35 Lakhs (inclusive of GST)

The tenderer should have satisfactorily completed one similar work to an extent of 50% of the cost of this work (amount put to tender with GST) ie. Rs.37.67 lakhs (inclusive of GST) during last 5 years.

Satisfactorily should have completed, as prime contractor, in any one year minimum quantities of works usually 80% of the annual requirement such as providing and laying of DI class K9 pipeline of 150mm dia and above for a length of 400 Rmt and 100mm dia and above for a length of 1040.00 Rmt in a continuous 12 months

Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than 30% of the amount of contract i.e. Rs.22.60 lakhs (inclusive of GST) (credit lines/letter of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc to be submitted.).
The Form of tender as per the Proforma available in KW-III should be duly filled and uploaded in the KPP portal as a part of tender document which is Mandatory and the rates should not be disclosed.

Each tenderer should further demonstrate (a) availability by owing at least 50% of the required/specified key & critical equipment for this work and (b) the remaining 50% can be deployed on lease / hire basis for all works provided, the relevant documents (commitment agreements etc.,) for availability for this work are to be furnished.
The amount put to tender is exclusive of GST and inclusive of area weightage (10%) and the rates quoted shall be exclusive of GST and inclusive of area weightage
Other details can be seen in the tender documents
